name: CrisisFlow Intelligence Analyst
description: Multi-source crisis intelligence analysis with timestamp refinement via Google Search, Snowflake Cortex enrichment, and self-correcting validation loops. Covers 996 ACLED conflict zones across 115 countries.

skills.name: Conflict Zone Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes ACLED conflict zones in a specified region: loads data from Snowflake via MCP, refines timestamps via parallel Google Search, validates results with a self-correction loop, enriches via Snowflake Cortex, and generates intelligence briefings.

skills.name: Response Coordinator Handoff
skills.description: Sends intelligence briefings to the Humanitarian Response Coordinator specialist agent via A2A protocol for action planning and alert generation.
